title: Trend Micro Control Manager AdHocQuery_SelectView XPATH Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within AdHocQuery_SelectView.aspx. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize user-supplied input prior to executing an XML query. An attacker can use this information in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the process.
